# Codename Udaan

> Official project information for Codename Udaan — a MahaRERA-registered luxury high-rise offering premium 1 & 2 BHK residences in Shahad (West), Kalyan, Maharashtra.

Codename Udaan is an iconic G+27 residential landmark on Shahad-Mohane Road with private balcony homes, 15+ lifestyle amenities, and connectivity approximately 5 minutes walking from Shahad Railway Station.

## Key facts

- Project name: Codename Udaan
- Location: Shahad-Mohane Road, Shahad (West), Kalyan, Thane, Maharashtra 421301, India
- Coordinates: 19.2568, 73.1558
- Configurations: 1 BHK Premium, 2 BHK Luxury
- Amenities: 15+ including clubhouse, gymnasium, children's play park, temple within complex, library, senior citizen pavilion, landscaped gardens, 24/7 CCTV
- Connectivity: ~5 minutes walking to Shahad Railway Station
- Tower: G+27 storey landmark
- Balcony: Private balcony 6'0" × 10'0"
- Dining: 8'0" × 5'0"
- 2 BHK Master Bedroom: 10'0" × 11'0"
- MahaRERA Registration No.: P51700006298
- Sales phone: +91 96191 24440
- Sales email: udaancodname@gmail.com
- Official website: https://codenameudaan.in/
- Pricing: Available on request via sales desk
